## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] `python -m py_compile` passes for the changed Python files.
- [ ] `python -m pytest` passes.
- [ ] The panel was checked at a desktop viewport when UI behavior changed.
- [ ] No video, FIT/GPX, token, personal path, log or map cache was added.

## Screenshots or logs

Attach anonymized evidence when it helps reviewers. Remove GPS locations, personal
paths, proxy details and API keys first.
